gaps.explanation: Statement (Exhibit H, accrual basis, trimmed p6 Totals 2025) prints Total operating revenues 359,240 + Interest income 63,121 = 422,361. The detail lines are the Schedule 5 (p13, budgetary cash basis) Proprietary receipts 1,251,394 split with Exhibit I cash flows (p7): Receipts from customers 358,459 (cash) + Interest earned 63,121 = 421,580 (plus Proceeds from long-term debt 829,814 recorded under other financing). Gap 781 = accrual operating revenues 359,240 - cash receipts from customers 358,459 (cash vs accrual: change in receivables / sales tax on the p7 reconciliation). Both printed totals are correct on their own basis; no fix.

Statement (Exhibit H accrual, p6): Total operating expenses 369,870 (incl. Depreciation 117,864) + Interest/fees paid on long-term debt 2,005 = 371,875. Detail is the single Schedule 5 (p13) Proprietary disbursements line 1,358,929 'Actual on Budgetary Basis' (budgetary cash), which per Exhibit I (p7) = payments to employees 106,330 + payments for supplies & services 166,905 (= 273,235) + purchase of capital assets 865,455 + interest/fees paid 2,361 + principal paid 40,000 + transfers to other funds 177,878 = 1,358,929 exactly. Gap -987,054 = capital purchases 865,455 + principal 40,000 + transfers 177,878 - depreciation 117,864 + cash/accrual differences (273,235 + 2,361 = 275,596 cash vs 369,870 - 117,864 + 2,005 = 254,011 accrual: +21,585, the accounts payable / payroll / sales tax changes on p7). 865,455 + 40,000 + 177,878 - 117,864 + 21,585 = 987,054. Different basis; no fix (Schedule 5 prints only one proprietary line).
